lessons: Engine Lua environments can remove a standard-library function even when generic Lua51/53 tests pass. Read actual availability before a live mutation; fail before setter/input, preserve state, use supported language operations and rerun the same meaningful cases with the unavailable binding nil.

When replacing only a diagnostic fault, explicitly retire owned bindings, preserve old counter interval and independent request probe, and record new counters as a separate interval. Do not erase product caches or replay uncertain setters/actions.

Exact single-candidate opening is distinct from restoring all native qualification. Read the actual allowed candidate and an originally legal alternative still refused, then separately prove original native order and actual queue.

Cumulative progress ledgers must derive all remaining lists and counts from the same finite case set; preserve old inconsistent artifacts with an explicit new normalization instead of silently rewriting historical counts.
